message: I don't really like the wireless headphones I bought (ORD-1017). I'd like my money back.

evidence.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, delivery_date, product_name, category, unit_price, quantity, order_total, payment_method, status, final_sale FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.orders WHERE customer_id = 'C007' AND order_id = 'ORD-1017'
SELECT refund_id, customer_id, order_id, request_date, amount, reason, decision FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_history WHERE customer_id = 'C007'

SELECT rule_id, category, reason_type, window_days, auto_approve_limit, outcome, rule_text FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_policy WHERE category = 'Electronics'
UNION ALL
SELECT rule_id, category, reason_type, window_days, auto_approve_limit, outcome, rule_text FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_policy WHERE category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Electronics change-of-mind returns are accepted only within 15 days of delivery and must be unopened.
Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: ORD-1017 is an Electronics order delivered 2026-08-20 (E1); with demo_today 2026-10-25, days_since_delivery is 66. R2 allows Electronics change-of-mind returns only within 15 days of delivery (R1 allows 30 days generally), so the request is outside the applicable window. The order is not final sale, not already refunded, under $200, and has no prior refunds (E1, E2), but no change-of-mind approval rule applies after the window has lapsed.

critique.reason: The proposal correctly rejects the change-of-mind request. ORD-1017 is Electronics category, reason_type changed_mind, with days_since_delivery=66. R2 enforces a 15-day window for Electronics change-of-mind returns (R1 allows 30 days generally). 66 days exceeds both windows. All factual claims (category, days_since_delivery, final_sale=false, already_refunded=false, order_total=149.0, no prior refunds) are supported by E1, E2, E3 and agree with the Python checks. No query can determine item condition (unopened), but the window lapse alone decides the outcome.

customer_reply: We're sorry you're not satisfied with the wireless headphones from order ORD-1017. Unfortunately, change-of-mind returns for Electronics items must be requested within 15 days of delivery, and your order was delivered on August 20, 2026, which is beyond that window. We hope you'll consider our other products in the future.
limitations: Could not verify whether the headphones were unopened, as required by the return policy.
